title: hornungia alpina subsp. auerswaldii
intro: Hornungia alpina subsp. auerswaldii, commonly known as Alpine Hornungia, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. It is a type of wild mustard that is native to the mountainous regions of Central Europe. The Alpine Hornungia plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, due to its rich content of antioxidants and other bioactive compounds. The therapeutic actions of this plant are thought to be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including isothiocyanates, glucosinolates, and phenolic compounds, which may also exhibit anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
